jobs: Himalayas API (including searches filtered to Kenya)
employer job boards on Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Recruitee and Workable

method.filtering_summary: Of about 4,500 postings pulled (aggregators plus about 50 employer boards), about 1,450 were more than 30 days old, about 2,010 had senior, lead or manager titles, about 760 weren’t target roles, and about 240 were limited to regions that exclude Kenya. The roughly 60 left were read closely; most failed on years of experience or a location rule in the employer's own posting.

stories.title: Cloudflare acquires Deno
stories.summary: Cloudflare is buying the company behind the Deno runtime (co-founded by Node.js creator Ryan Dahl) to improve its Workers programming model; terms weren't disclosed, and Deno had raised $26 million.
stories.why: Workers and Deno are common hosts for webhooks and small APIs like the ones he builds; expect the two to merge.

stories.title: Nadella calls for an 'emergency brake' on AI models
stories.summary: Microsoft's CEO said AI systems should separate the model from the harness, externalise safeguards, log every meaningful model action as tamper-proof evidence, and let an authorised person pause or stop a model mid-task.
stories.why: Harness design, guardrails and audit logs are becoming expected parts of agent work, which is useful framing for agent-engineering interviews.

stories.title: Nvidia in early talks over Reflection AI
stories.summary: Per the FT, Nvidia may buy, acquihire or invest more in Reflection AI, which unveiled its 501-billion-parameter open-weight model Beam five days earlier; Nvidia has put $800 million into it so far.
stories.why: Another big bet on open-weight coding-agent models he could run or build on.

stories.title: OPay files for a US IPO
stories.summary: The Nigerian-led fintech filed a US prospectus and is considering a secondary NGX listing; H1 2026 revenue was $467.1 million (up 136%), with net income of $90.9 million.
stories.why: A large African fintech going public, driven by lending, which is the same space as Kwara's loan products.

stories.title: Amazon in talks to buy Decart for up to $7 billion
stories.summary: Per the WSJ, Amazon is discussing buying Decart, whose DOS software ports AI models across chips; Decart raised $300 million at a $4 billion valuation in May.
stories.why: Shows how much buyers will pay for AI infrastructure tooling startups.

stories.title: Apple strikes a reverse acqui-hire with Huxe
stories.summary: An EU filing shows Apple agreed to make offers to certain Huxe AI employees and take a non-exclusive licence to its IP; Huxe, from ex-NotebookLM developers, shut down in May.
stories.why: Big tech keeps hiring AI teams without buying the company, a pattern to watch at small AI startups.

stories.title: US developer postings are up, but mostly for senior and AI roles
stories.summary: Indeed data shows US software-development postings up almost 15% since February 2025; 71% of the May 2025-May 2026 increase was senior roles and 37% AI-titled jobs, while Stanford reports employment for developers aged 22-25 down nearly 20% from 2024.
stories.why: Entry-level demand is still weak, so AI-integration skills and client-facing roles are the better way in.

stories.title: Jubilee and FSD Africa's BimaLab pick 7 insurtechs for Kenyan pilots
stories.summary: Seven insurtechs, including Dukatech, Inclusivity Solutions, Agrails and Ibisa, join an eight-week co-creation programme with Jubilee, with pilots for small businesses, informal workers and farmers starting in November 2026.
stories.why: Embedded insurance via APIs and existing transactions is integration work close to his fintech background.

stories.title: Kenyans can buy Dangote shares as NSE-listed GDRs from Sh535
stories.summary: The GDR offer closes 5pm EAT on Tuesday October 13; the minimum is 10 GDRs at Sh53.50 each, and trading on the NSE starts December 8, 2026.
stories.why: A new cross-border investment product on Kenya's exchange, relevant to local fintech and investing apps.
